exercises.title: Lab 6 — FUHCompany management reports
exercises.problemHtml:
Lab 6 — FUHCompany management reports

DBI202 · Chapter 6 — SQL queries · Suggested time: 90 minutes · Total: 10 marks (8 × 1.25)

1. Overview

The board of FUHCompany asks for eight management reports. The database is the course's sample company (7 tables: employees, departments, projects, assignments, locations, department offices, dependents). Write each report as one standard SQL query in its own file — the same rules as the Practical Exam.

Main features

  • Filtering text and dates, joining up to four tables.
  • Counting with outer joins, grouping, HAVING.
  • Relational division and minimum-per-group with ties.

General requirements

  • Column names/aliases and their order exactly as listed; row order only matters when the question says "order by".
  • Standard SQL that runs on both SQL Server and PostgreSQL: no TOP/LIMIT, ISNULL/IFNULL, YEAR(), ILIKE, ::. Text compares case-insensitively, as on SQL Server.
  • Never hard-code numbers you can read from the data (hidden checks change the data).

2. Submission files

RollNo_Name_DBI202_Lab6/
├── Q1.sql    -- Staff living in TP Hồ Chí Minh (1.25 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- Project directory (1.25 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- Projects per location, including empty locations (1.25 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- Born in the 1980s (1.25 marks)
├── Q5.sql    -- Busy projects (1.25 marks)
├── Q6.sql    -- Departments and their managers (1.25 marks)
├── Q7.sql    -- All projects of their own department (division) (1.25 marks)
├── Q8.sql    -- Lowest paid of each department (1.25 marks)

3. Data model

tblEmployee

FieldTypeNotes
empSSNDECIMAL(18,0)PK
empNameNVARCHAR(50)
empAddressNVARCHAR(100)NULL allowed
empSalaryDECIMAL(10,0)> 0
empSexCHAR(1)'F' / 'M'
empBirthdateDATENULL allowed
depNumINTFK → tblDepartment
supervisorSSNDECIMAL(18,0)FK → tblEmployee (NULL = director)

tblDepartment

FieldTypeNotes
depNumINTPK
depNameNVARCHAR(50)UNIQUE
mgrSSNDECIMAL(18,0)FK → tblEmployee (manager)
mgrAssDateDATE

tblProject

FieldTypeNotes
proNumINTPK
proNameNVARCHAR(50)
locNumINTFK → tblLocation
depNumINTFK → tblDepartment (controlling department)

tblWorksOn

FieldTypeNotes
empSSN, proNumDECIMAL(18,0), INTPK; FKs
workHoursDECIMAL(5,1)≥ 0

tblLocation · tblDepLocation · tblDependent

FieldTypeNotes
tblLocationlocNum PK, locName UNIQUE
tblDepLocation(depNum, locNum) PKoffices of departments
tblDependent(empSSN, depName) PKdepSex, depBirthdate, depRelationship

4. Functional requirements

1. Staff living in TP Hồ Chí Minh 1.25 marks

Employees whose address ends with "TP Hồ Chí Minh".

Requirements:

  • Columns: empSSN, empName, empAddress; order by empSSN.

2. Project directory 1.25 marks

Every project with the name of its controlling department and of its location.

Requirements:

  • Columns: proNum, proName, depName, locName; order by proNum.

3. Projects per location, including empty locations 1.25 marks

For every location, the number of projects located there (0 if none).

Requirements:

  • Columns: locNum, locName, NumProjects; order by locNum.

4. Born in the 1980s 1.25 marks

Employees born from 1 January 1980 to 31 December 1989, with their department name.

Requirements:

  • Columns: empSSN, empName, empBirthdate, depName; order by empBirthdate.
  • Use a date range, not YEAR() (SQL Server only, and not index-friendly).

5. Busy projects 1.25 marks

Projects whose total working hours are at least 50, with the number of people and the total hours.

Requirements:

  • Columns: proNum, proName, NumStaff, TotalHours; order by TotalHours descending, then proNum.

6. Departments and their managers 1.25 marks

Every department with its manager's name and the number of employees in the department.

Requirements:

  • Columns: depNum, depName, ManagerName, NumEmployees; order by depNum.

7. All projects of their own department (division) 1.25 marks

Employees who work on every project controlled by their own department. Only consider departments that control at least one project.

Requirements:

  • Columns: empSSN, empName, depNum; order by empSSN.

8. Lowest paid of each department 1.25 marks

For each department, the employee(s) with the lowest salary in that department (all of them on a tie).

Requirements:

  • Columns: depNum, empSSN, empName, empSalary; order by depNum, then empSSN.

5. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Staff living in TP Hồ Chí Minh1.25
2Project directory1.25
3Projects per location, including empty locations1.25
4Born in the 1980s1.25
5Busy projects1.25
6Departments and their managers1.25
7All projects of their own department (division)1.25
8Lowest paid of each department1.25
Total10

Common deductions

  • Wrong column names/aliases or column order — the checker compares columns by position and name.
  • INNER JOIN where the question says "every … including …" (Q3, Q6).
  • TOP 1 / FETCH 1 ROW for "the lowest" — drops ties (Q8).
  • Hard-coded numbers that only match today's data — hidden checks change the data.

6. Submission

Write each answer in its own tab (Q1.sql … Q8.sql). Run = sample checks; Submit = all checks (hidden ones change the data). The FUHCompany.sql tab is the database script — run it in SSMS to practise on real SQL Server.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Lab 6 — FUHCompany management reports

DBI202 · Chương 6 — Truy vấn SQL · Thời gian gợi ý: 90 phút · Tổng: 10 điểm (8 × 1,25)

1. Tổng quan

Ban giám đốc FUHCompany cần tám báo cáo quản trị. CSDL là công ty mẫu của môn (7 bảng: nhân viên, phòng, dự án, phân công, địa điểm, văn phòng của phòng, người phụ thuộc). Viết mỗi báo cáo bằng một câu SQL chuẩn trong tệp riêng — cùng quy định như bài thi thực hành.

Chức năng chính

  • Lọc chữ và ngày, nối tới bốn bảng.
  • Đếm có outer join, gộp nhóm, HAVING.
  • Phép chia quan hệ và nhỏ nhất theo nhóm có hoà.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Tên cột/bí danh và thứ tự cột đúng như đề; thứ tự dòng chỉ quan trọng khi đề ghi "sắp theo".
  • SQL chuẩn chạy cả SQL Server lẫn PostgreSQL: không TOP/LIMIT, ISNULL, YEAR(), ILIKE, ::. Chuỗi so không phân biệt hoa thường như SQL Server.
  • Không chép cứng con số đọc được từ dữ liệu (kiểm ẩn đổi dữ liệu).

2. Tệp nộp bài

RollNo_Name_DBI202_Lab6/
├── Q1.sql    -- Staff living in TP Hồ Chí Minh (1.25 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- Project directory (1.25 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- Projects per location, including empty locations (1.25 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- Born in the 1980s (1.25 marks)
├── Q5.sql    -- Busy projects (1.25 marks)
├── Q6.sql    -- Departments and their managers (1.25 marks)
├── Q7.sql    -- All projects of their own department (division) (1.25 marks)
├── Q8.sql    -- Lowest paid of each department (1.25 marks)

3. Mô hình dữ liệu

tblEmployee

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
empSSNDECIMAL(18,0)PK
empNameNVARCHAR(50)
empAddressNVARCHAR(100)NULL allowed
empSalaryDECIMAL(10,0)> 0
empSexCHAR(1)'F' / 'M'
empBirthdateDATENULL allowed
depNumINTFK → tblDepartment
supervisorSSNDECIMAL(18,0)FK → tblEmployee (NULL = director)

tblDepartment

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
depNumINTPK
depNameNVARCHAR(50)UNIQUE
mgrSSNDECIMAL(18,0)FK → tblEmployee (manager)
mgrAssDateDATE

tblProject

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
proNumINTPK
proNameNVARCHAR(50)
locNumINTFK → tblLocation
depNumINTFK → tblDepartment (controlling department)

tblWorksOn

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
empSSN, proNumDECIMAL(18,0), INTPK; FKs
workHoursDECIMAL(5,1)≥ 0

tblLocation · tblDepLocation · tblDependent

TrườngKiểuGhi chú
tblLocationlocNum PK, locName UNIQUE
tblDepLocation(depNum, locNum) PKoffices of departments
tblDependent(empSSN, depName) PKdepSex, depBirthdate, depRelationship

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. Nhân viên sống ở TP Hồ Chí Minh 1.25 điểm

Nhân viên có địa chỉ kết thúc bằng "TP Hồ Chí Minh".

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: empSSN, empName, empAddress; sắp theo empSSN.

2. Danh bạ dự án 1.25 điểm

Mọi dự án kèm tên phòng quản lý và tên địa điểm.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: proNum, proName, depName, locName; sắp theo proNum.

3. Số dự án mỗi địa điểm, kể cả địa điểm trống 1.25 điểm

Với mọi địa điểm, số dự án đặt tại đó (0 nếu không có).

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: locNum, locName, NumProjects; sắp theo locNum.

4. Sinh trong thập niên 1980 1.25 điểm

Nhân viên sinh từ 01/01/1980 đến 31/12/1989, kèm tên phòng.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: empSSN, empName, empBirthdate, depName; sắp theo empBirthdate.
  • Dùng khoảng ngày, không YEAR() (chỉ SQL Server và không dùng được chỉ mục).

5. Dự án bận rộn 1.25 điểm

Dự án có tổng giờ làm từ 50 trở lên, kèm số người và tổng giờ.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: proNum, proName, NumStaff, TotalHours; sắp TotalHours giảm dần, rồi proNum.

6. Các phòng và trưởng phòng 1.25 điểm

Mọi phòng kèm tên trưởng phòng và số nhân viên của phòng.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: depNum, depName, ManagerName, NumEmployees; sắp theo depNum.

7. Làm mọi dự án của phòng mình (phép chia) 1.25 điểm

Nhân viên làm mọi dự án do phòng của họ quản lý. Chỉ xét phòng có ít nhất một dự án.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: empSSN, empName, depNum; sắp theo empSSN.

8. Lương thấp nhất mỗi phòng 1.25 điểm

Với mỗi phòng, (các) nhân viên lương thấp nhất phòng (hoà thì hiện hết).

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: depNum, empSSN, empName, empSalary; sắp theo depNum, rồi empSSN.

5. Thang điểm

#Chức năngĐiểm
1Nhân viên sống ở TP Hồ Chí Minh1.25
2Danh bạ dự án1.25
3Số dự án mỗi địa điểm, kể cả địa điểm trống1.25
4Sinh trong thập niên 19801.25
5Dự án bận rộn1.25
6Các phòng và trưởng phòng1.25
7Làm mọi dự án của phòng mình (phép chia)1.25
8Lương thấp nhất mỗi phòng1.25
Tổng10

Lỗi hay bị trừ điểm

  • Sai tên/bí danh hay thứ tự cột — máy chấm so cột theo vị trí và tên.
  • Dùng INNER JOIN khi đề ghi "mọi … kể cả …" (Q3, Q6).
  • TOP 1 / FETCH 1 ROW cho "thấp nhất" — mất dòng hoà (Q8).
  • Chép cứng con số chỉ khớp dữ liệu hôm nay — kiểm ẩn đổi dữ liệu.

6. Nộp bài

Viết mỗi câu trong tab riêng (Q1.sql … Q8.sql). Chạy thử = kiểm mẫu; Nộp = mọi kiểm (kiểm ẩn đổi dữ liệu). Tab FUHCompany.sql là script CSDL — chạy trong SSMS để luyện trên SQL Server thật.

-- FUHCompany.sql: sample schema + data of this task (READ ONLY — the grader loads it by itself; editing this tab changes nothing).
-- FUHCompany.sql: lược đồ + dữ liệu mẫu của bài (CHỈ ĐỂ ĐỌC — máy chấm tự nạp; sửa tab này không ảnh hưởng gì).
-- Written in SQL Server syntax, like the PE's DBscript.sql — runs as-is in SSMS.
CREATE TABLE tblLocation (
    locNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    locName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_location      PRIMARY KEY (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_location_name UNIQUE (locName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepartment (
    depNum      INT            NOT NULL,
    depName     NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    mgrSSN      DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    mgrAssDate  DATE           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_department      PRIMARY KEY (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_department_name UNIQUE (depName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblEmployee (
    empSSN         DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    empName        NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empAddress     NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
    empSalary      DECIMAL(10,0)  NULL,
    empSex         CHAR(1)        NULL,
    empBirthdate   DATE           NULL,
    depNum         INT            NULL,
    supervisorSSN  DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_employee            PRIMARY KEY (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_sex        CHECK (empSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_salary     CHECK (empSalary > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum)        REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_supervisor FOREIGN KEY (supervisorSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepLocation (
    depNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    locNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_deplocation            PRIMARY KEY (depNum, locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblProject (
    proNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    proName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    locNum   INT           NULL,
    depNum   INT           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_project            PRIMARY KEY (proNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblWorksOn (
    empSSN     DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    proNum     INT            NOT NULL,
    workHours  DECIMAL(5,1)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_workson          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, proNum),
    CONSTRAINT ck_workson_hours    CHECK (workHours >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_project  FOREIGN KEY (proNum) REFERENCES tblProject (proNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDependent (
    depName          NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empSSN           DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    depSex           CHAR(1)        NULL,
    depBirthdate     DATE           NULL,
    depRelationship  NVARCHAR(30)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_dependent          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, depName),
    CONSTRAINT ck_dependent_sex      CHECK (depSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT fk_dependent_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

ALTER TABLE tblDepartment
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_department_manager FOREIGN KEY (mgrSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN);

solutionCodeJson.name: Q1.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT empSSN, empName, empAddress
FROM tblEmployee
WHERE empAddress LIKE N'%TP Hồ Chí Minh'
ORDER BY empSSN;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q2.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT p.proNum, p.proName, d.depName, l.locName
FROM tblProject p
JOIN tblDepartment d ON d.depNum = p.depNum
JOIN tblLocation  l ON l.locNum = p.locNum
ORDER BY p.proNum;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q3.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT l.locNum, l.locName, COUNT(p.proNum) AS NumProjects
FROM tblLocation l
LEFT JOIN tblProject p ON p.locNum = l.locNum
GROUP BY l.locNum, l.locName
ORDER BY l.locNum;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q4.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT e.empSSN, e.empName, e.empBirthdate, d.depName
FROM tblEmployee e
JOIN tblDepartment d ON d.depNum = e.depNum
WHERE e.empBirthdate >= '1980-01-01' AND e.empBirthdate < '1990-01-01'
ORDER BY e.empBirthdate;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q5.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT p.proNum, p.proName, COUNT(*) AS NumStaff, SUM(w.workHours) AS TotalHours
FROM tblProject p
JOIN tblWorksOn w ON w.proNum = p.proNum
GROUP BY p.proNum, p.proName
HAVING SUM(w.workHours) >= 50
ORDER BY TotalHours DESC, p.proNum;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q6.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT d.depNum, d.depName, m.empName AS ManagerName,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblEmployee e WHERE e.depNum = d.depNum) AS NumEmployees
FROM tblDepartment d
LEFT JOIN tblEmployee m ON m.empSSN = d.mgrSSN   -- the manager is ALSO a row of tblEmployee
ORDER BY d.depNum;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q7.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT e.empSSN, e.empName, e.depNum
FROM tblEmployee e
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tblProject p WHERE p.depNum = e.depNum)        -- the department has projects
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1                                                 -- no project of the department…
                  FROM tblProject p
                  WHERE p.depNum = e.depNum
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tblWorksOn w             -- …that the employee does NOT work on
                                    WHERE w.empSSN = e.empSSN AND w.proNum = p.proNum))
ORDER BY e.empSSN;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q8.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT e.depNum, e.empSSN, e.empName, e.empSalary
FROM tblEmployee e
WHERE e.empSalary = (SELECT MIN(x.empSalary) FROM tblEmployee x WHERE x.depNum = e.depNum)
ORDER BY e.depNum, e.empSSN;

-- Written in SQL Server syntax, like the PE's DBscript.sql — runs as-is in SSMS.
CREATE TABLE tblLocation (
    locNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    locName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_location      PRIMARY KEY (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_location_name UNIQUE (locName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepartment (
    depNum      INT            NOT NULL,
    depName     NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    mgrSSN      DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    mgrAssDate  DATE           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_department      PRIMARY KEY (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_department_name UNIQUE (depName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblEmployee (
    empSSN         DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    empName        NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empAddress     NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
    empSalary      DECIMAL(10,0)  NULL,
    empSex         CHAR(1)        NULL,
    empBirthdate   DATE           NULL,
    depNum         INT            NULL,
    supervisorSSN  DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_employee            PRIMARY KEY (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_sex        CHECK (empSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_salary     CHECK (empSalary > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum)        REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_supervisor FOREIGN KEY (supervisorSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepLocation (
    depNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    locNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_deplocation            PRIMARY KEY (depNum, locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblProject (
    proNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    proName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    locNum   INT           NULL,
    depNum   INT           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_project            PRIMARY KEY (proNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblWorksOn (
    empSSN     DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    proNum     INT            NOT NULL,
    workHours  DECIMAL(5,1)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_workson          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, proNum),
    CONSTRAINT ck_workson_hours    CHECK (workHours >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_project  FOREIGN KEY (proNum) REFERENCES tblProject (proNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDependent (
    depName          NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empSSN           DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    depSex           CHAR(1)        NULL,
    depBirthdate     DATE           NULL,
    depRelationship  NVARCHAR(30)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_dependent          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, depName),
    CONSTRAINT ck_dependent_sex      CHECK (depSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT fk_dependent_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

ALTER TABLE tblDepartment
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_department_manager FOREIGN KEY (mgrSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN);
